cohort: 473 patients with isolated fever in labor and 1135 patients with clinical chorioamnionitis at BC Women's Hospital between January 2011 and April 2016
finding: Slightly higher maternal temperature was associated with increased treatment, including antibiotic use, saline bolus administration, and blood cultures in women with isolated fever in labor.
mod_finding: Cesarean delivery rates were lower in the isolated fever in labor group compared to the clinical chorioamnionitis group.
